in_marathi.name: Biswajeet
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of all knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Biswajeet हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Biswajit means 'the lord of all knowledge'. It is derived from two Sanskrit words: 'Biswa' meaning 'all' and 'Jit' meaning 'conqueror'. According to Hindu mythology, Biswajit is the name of a god who imparts wisdom and knowledge to his devotees.
